description: This source file defines data structures, enumerations, and functions related to managing session data in an application. It includes representations for session records, token statistics, session rows, session kinds, loading mechanisms, and utility functions for relative age calculation. The file interacts with a gateway to load session data, and provides models for displaying session information in a user interface.

classes.name: SessionTokenStats
classes.description: Represents token counts for input, output, total, and context tokens within a session, with computed summaries.

classes.name: SessionRow
classes.description: Models a row of session data, including identifiers, metadata, token statistics, and helper properties for UI display.

classes.name: SessionKind
classes.description: Enumerates the types of sessions (direct, group, global, unknown) with associated labels and display colors.

classes.name: SessionDefaults
classes.description: Holds default model and context token count for sessions.

classes.name: SessionStoreSnapshot
classes.description: Encapsulates a snapshot of session store data including the path, defaults, and rows.

methods.name: loadSnapshot
methods.description: Asynchronously loads a snapshot of session data from the gateway, decoding JSON data into session models.

methods.name: loadRows
methods.description: Asynchronously loads only the session rows from the store.

methods.name: standardize
methods.description: Converts a file path to a standardized, expanded form.
